tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding. An answer item with empty selected and no custom means the user skipped that question: continue without it, do not ask it again, and do not treat the skip as permission.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: benchmark_fixture
tools.description: Read fixed mock business state. First initialize with the exact run_id from the benchmark prompt; read returns only currently released facts. submit records actual user-confirmed draft values and returns a staged mock receipt. Never submit before user confirmation. No real business actions, external network or unreleased future events.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Look up current weather and a short daily forecast for a place, from Open-Meteo (no API key). Call it before recommending clothing or planning an outdoor activity, and ground every temperature, rain, wind, or UV claim in the numbers it returns. It requires a known place: if the user has not named one, collect it first with the render_ui form (mode "form", intent "generic_filters") instead of guessing a city or calling this tool without a location.

location.description: Place name to look up, such as "Shanghai", "Kyoto", or "Berlin, Germany".

days.description: How many days of daily outlook to include, 1 to 7. Defaults to 4.

tools.name: render_ui
tools.description:
Generate a user-facing interface from supplied facts using json-render. Available as one presentation option alongside ordinary replies and ask_user_question.
mode=display renders information and continues the turn; mode=form renders a form and ends the turn on success, waiting for a user submission.
Put factual content and real field values in business_data. Describe the layout in user_query, at most 2000 characters.
Use intent=generic_filters for form fields or generic_pick_one for real candidate choices. List required rich component names in components.
For Image in this installed adapter, use business_data={"image":"<provided URL string>","alt":"<provided description>"}; request Image.props.src as that fixed string. Do not invent a URL or use a default demonstration image.
A display needs the complete relevant facts and a written fallback. Failures are not successful displays. Do not repeat an unchanged failed call.

mode.description: display renders a read-only layout and continues the turn. form renders a form and ends the turn on success. mode does not select the catalog.

user_query.description: Layout instruction in the user language, at most 2000 characters. Name every requested component explicitly and put facts in business_data.

answer_presentation.description: Display only: replace shows the complete interface instead of closing prose; supplement keeps the written answer beside the card.

intent.description: generic_filters or generic_pick_one for those forms. rich_content when the layout needs the rich catalog even if components is omitted. Omit for ordinary display.

components.description: Every rich component this layout needs. Any one selects rich_content for the whole page, including a mix with base or form components.

prompt_mode.description: Optional server prompt mode. Only full or progressive.

scene.description: Optional scene hint passed through to the renderer, such as kb.

locale.description: Optional locale hint, such as zh-CN.

business_data.description: Structured facts the card must show. Required and must be non-empty for display and form. Include every requested value, title, description, number, and warning.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

data.system:
Create a concise title for an AI coding-assistant session from the supplied human messages.
Return only the title on one line, **in plain text of natural language**, with no quotes, prefix, explanation, Markdown, XML, or terminal control codes. No code is allowed.
Use the language of the messages.
Aim for about 5 words in non-CJK languages or 10 CJK characters.
If the messages give little to name, still return a short best-effort title, such as Greeting, instead of explaining.

Facts: original request: 2026-11-07, 19:00–20:00, 4 people, whiteboard and projection, venue 四明书院. User now says: drop whiteboard, time changed to after 8pm (20:00之后). Since the whiteboard is dropped, only projection needed. But time range is unspecified — "8点之后" open-ended, so we need a form for legal alternative time slots. But available slots are unknown — 未释放的事实保持未知，可用时段未知，以模拟提交返回为准.

So the conflict: original time 19:00–20:00 conflicts with new constraint "after 20:00"; the new end time not specified. We need user to specify time slot (start/end after 20:00). We shouldn't default-accept.

Constraint: render_ui with mode=form, intent=generic_filters (form fields), components: only specified component — "冲突说明+合法替代时段表单". Rich components listed as needed names only? "仅生成本题指定的组件，其他rich组件列出所需名称。" Hmm, this means: only render the components specified for this task; other rich components — just list the required names. Which rich components? The specified presentation is 冲突说明 + 合法替代时段表单. There are no rich components needed (no image). So we should list needed rich component names... Maybe the instruction means if rich components are needed, list names in `components`. Since none are needed, we can list empty or state none.

Actually the safest: use render_ui mode=form, intent=generic_filters, with business_data containing the conflict explanation and the original facts + the time slot field options. Since available slots are unknown, options should be constrained legal alternatives after 20:00? But we don't know availability. So the form should let user specify start time and end time after 20:00, plus maybe communicate that available slots will be confirmed on submit.

Hmm "合法替代时段表单" — a form of legal alternative time slots. Legal = consistent with new constraints: whiteboard dropped, only projection, start ≥ 20:00, 4 people, 2026-11-07, 四明书院. Since actual availability unknown, we present candidate choices of times after 20:00? But we cannot invent availability of slots — inventing offered slots isn't a fact claim about availability if we frame them as "preferences to be confirmed". But careful: "不得编造事实、候选项". So we should avoid making up candidate slots labeled available. Instead, form fields: 开始时间 / 结束时间 as input, with note that start must be ≥20:00 and availability will be confirmed after submit.

However, perhaps form with select options for typical hour blocks after 20:00 is acceptable as "偏好" not availability. Risky. Better: use text/number fields. But do we know form component capabilities? render_ui with generic_filters generates a form; we just describe fields in user_query and put values in business_data.

The user's choice is "no slot selected / keep requirement" — that's not a draft time change. Submitting a "no time" draft? The fixture submit requires values reflecting confirmed draft values. Here user didn't confirm a new time slot. So probably no submit needed — nothing to stage. But maybe we should record that no time change is made and requirement stays. Submitting values with 未选定 would be submitting an unconfirmed/invalid draft. Hmm.

The instruction says submit only after user confirmation, with actual user-confirmed draft values. Here the user confirmed: no slot selected, keep 20:00+ requirement. There's no valid draft time to stage — the draft remains the old conflicting one (19:00–20:00, whiteboard removed?). Actually whiteboard removal was confirmed earlier.

I think safest: do not submit a fake draft. Instead finalize with a clear statement: no time slot selected, requirement stands, no reservation, current known availability doesn't include anything after 20:00; nothing staged/changed. Offer next steps: 改期到其他日期、换场地、或另议 — but without inventing facts/availability.

But could we submit to record "未选择时段" as actual confirmed value? That risks staging an incorrect draft. The submit spec: "submit records actual user-confirmed draft values and returns a staged mock receipt." The user-confirmed values here = keep 20:00+ requirement, no slot chosen, whiteboard cancelled, others unchanged. There's no valid time. I think skipping submit is correct — nothing to confirm that can be submitted as a valid draft. Actually, hmm — one could argue we should not submit because there's no new draft time; the honest answer is "no draft change staged".

I'll give final answer: 保留需求，未选定任何时段，未提交草稿改动，不实际预约。列出当前已核实：当日可用仅两个早于20:00的时段。下一步需你决定：改日期/换场地/放松时间要求 — but I shouldn't invent availability. Ask which direction, or just state I'll wait. Since presentation is already done, a text answer is fine. Maybe ask a short question via ask_user_question? Not necessary — could be helpful but the preset says only ask when necessary. I'll provide text with options and wait.

Actually it may be useful to offer a next-step question. But the specified presentation for this task was 冲突说明+合法替代时段表单, already delivered. Now conclude in text. Keep it concise, no protocol explanation.

已按你的选择处理：**没有选定任何时段**，你的“20:00 之后”要求保持不变。

- 未提交任何新的时段，草稿时间仍未被替换成一个可用档期
- 已确认的改动只有取消白板，设施保留投屏
- 其余条件不变：2026-11-07、4 人、四明书院
- 未实际预约，也没有产生任何预约结果

目前核实到的情况是：2026-11-07 当天可用时段只有 14:00–15:00 和 16:00–17:00，都在 20:00 之前，因此当天没有能满足你要求的时段。

要继续推进，需要你定一个方向：换一个日期、换一个场地，或者放宽“20:00 之后”这条时间要求。你说了我再按新条件去核对，不会自行改动或默认接受。
